[INFO] Windows Search Catalog Corruption aggregated digest

Use case: UC-1.2.88 — Windows Search Catalog Corruption
Severity tier: low (digest)

This item is included in the informational digest. Review during the next scheduled triage window unless correlated with higher-severity activity.

Reports one row for each Microsoft Windows Search Application event indicating corrupt index data and an attempted rebuild (7040) or Search service shutdown because the catalog is corrupt (7042). The provider-qualified result preserves raw identity and message; it does not infer that rebuilding succeeded or that users were affected.
